_meta.purpose: TEMPLATE. Your n-of-1 experiments: the pre-registered protocol, compliance marks and results. PERSONAL — do not pass it on.
_meta.how_to_fill: Not meant to be edited by hand. The registration and logging tools live in the project's source tree (src/ingest/nof1.py) and are not part of the installed package; ready-made protocols are in knowledge/experiment_templates.json.
_meta.rule: A protocol is not amended after it starts: changing the metric or the length makes a NEW experiment, and the old one is closed as it stands. A day with no compliance mark counts as UNKNOWN, not as complied.
_meta.shape: experiments: [{ id, registered, status, hypothesis, primary_metric, direction, secondary_metrics[], phase_days, blocks, washout_days, alpha, randomization_seed, schedule[{n,label,start,end}], min_achievable_p, feasible, compliance_log{YYYY-MM-DD: {ok, note}} }]
